scenario: [LGRA.24.3]: a block fact enters at the engine's first step, under that step's sample, so its entry stamp is the step's monotonic sample ([LTIM.2.8.6]), not the instant of the load. The test clock is set to 100 s before anything steps; the first step is the pump, which applies the block and then evaluates the rules. `fresh` matches a `Ping` only `within 2_s` of its entry stamp ([LTIM.2.7.1], read under the pump's sample); `any` matches every `Ping`, so the pump is shown to have run with the fact present. (`dwell` would say the same, but it is defined on a `logical` schema only ([LFAC.1.2.4]), and a block places `scope explicit` facts.) Pin: `fresh` then `any`. A runtime that applied the block at load, stamping the fact 0, is 100 s past the window at the pump and logs `any` alone. PATH PINNED: the first step's application under its sample -- libds's `ds_engine_clock_step` into `dsc/loader.c`'s `ds_engine_initial_apply`, a nested `ds_engine_assert` that takes the step's held sample as its entry stamp; the Mercury runtime's `clock_step` into `ds.engine.lgra_24_3_apply`, `host_assert_core` with `Own = no`.
rules_ds:
schema Ping scope explicit:
    k: Int

initial:
    Ping k: 1

rule fresh:
    Ping within 2_s
->
    log info "fresh"

rule any:
    Ping
->
    log info "any"
